categories.main_business_segments: SMIC is a leading integrated circuit wafer foundry company primarily engaged in semiconductor wafer manufacturing and testing. It offers 8-inch and 12-inch wafer foundry services, design services, IP support, photomask manufacturing, and related one-stop supporting services. The company also promotes upstream and downstream collaboration in the integrated circuit industry chain to provide comprehensive IC solutions.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: SMIC possesses a comprehensive core technology system for integrated circuit wafer foundry, including multiple technology platforms for 8-inch and 12-inch wafers. Key technology platforms under development include 28nm ultra-low leakage, 55nm high-voltage display, 65nm RF SOI, 90nm BCD, 8-inch BCD and analog, 0.18 micron embedded memory for automotive, and 8-inch high-voltage display driver technologies. The company follows a rigorous R&D process with seven stages from project selection to product mass production, emphasizing innovation, platform construction, and IP protection.
categories.primary_customers_markets: SMIC serves global customers including integrated circuit design companies and IDM enterprises across various sectors such as smartphones, computers and tablets, consumer electronics, internet and wearable devices, industrial and automotive electronics. The top five customers accounted for 36% of revenue in 2024, with no single customer exceeding 10%. The company also collaborates with leading enterprises in consumer electronics, automotive, IoT, industrial control, and AI sectors.
categories.geographic_coverage: SMIC operates primarily in Mainland China with major manufacturing facilities in Shanghai, Beijing, Tianjin, Shenzhen, and other locations. It maintains international marketing and service offices in the United States, Europe, Japan, and Taiwan to support global customers. In 2024, approximately 85% of revenue was from China, 12% from the United States, and 3% from Eurasia.
categories.supply_chain_position: SMIC operates as a midstream semiconductor foundry, providing wafer manufacturing and related technical services. It is a critical link in the semiconductor supply chain, bridging upstream design and downstream packaging/testing. The company also integrates upstream and downstream resources by offering design services, IP support, and photomask manufacturing to enhance the industry ecosystem.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes high-quality development, innovation-driven growth, and technology leadership by benchmarking world-class enterprises. It focuses on expanding technology platforms, accelerating process iteration and product upgrades, and enhancing customer satisfaction. SMIC invests heavily in R&D (9.4% of revenue in 2024) with a strong team of over 2,300 R&D personnel. It emphasizes developing differentiated technology platforms, expanding capacity, and strengthening industry chain collaboration to build competitive barriers.
categories.revenue_model: SMIC generates revenue primarily through wafer foundry services, including manufacturing and testing of integrated circuits. It also earns income from design services, IP support, photomask manufacturing, and other supporting services. Revenue is recognized upon transfer of control of goods or services, mainly through direct sales to customers. The company does not rely on subscription or licensing models.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: SMIC is one of the world's leading integrated circuit wafer foundry companies and the largest in Mainland China. It ranks second globally among pure-play foundries by sales revenue in 2024. The company faces intense competition from global industry leaders with more advanced technologies and higher market shares. SMIC differentiates itself through localized manufacturing, platform diversity, and comprehensive service offerings.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, SMIC achieved record sales revenue of RMB 57.8 billion, a 27.7% increase year-over-year, with a gross margin of 18.6% and EBITDA margin of 54.6%. The company’s total assets reached approximately RMB 353.4 billion, and wafer monthly capacity reached 948,000 8-inch equivalent wafers. Net profit attributable to shareholders was RMB 3.7 billion, down 23.3% from 2023, mainly due to decreased investment income. The company maintains strong cash flow and continues capital expenditure for capacity expansion.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: SMIC emphasizes its comprehensive technology platforms, strong R&D capabilities, and integrated service ecosystem to provide one-stop wafer foundry and technical services. It offers diversified process technologies tailored to various end markets including logic, analog, RF, embedded memory, and specialty processes. The company’s localized manufacturing in China, combined with global operational reach and industry chain collaboration, provides customers with supply chain stability and customized solutions. SMIC also highlights its robust IP portfolio and quality management systems as key competitive advantages.
